messages:
ashley: Heads up — steady tail-latency spike on pool7 since ~09:12. I traced a hot host: gpu-pool7-003 (card 3). Ops alert fired for page-retire count increase.

ops-bot: ALERT: page_retire_threshold exceeded on gpu-pool7-003:gpu3 (page_retire_delta 38 over 24h) — automated drain recommended.

maria: I can see the anomaly on the metric dashboard. dmesg on the host shows repeated Xid 31 and a handful of corrected ECCs.

ashley: run (pasted output):
```
$ sudo nvidia-smi -q -i 3 | egrep "Page Retired|Row Remap|ECC Errors"
  Page Retired Count                        : 142
  Row Remap Count                           : 58
  ECC Errors Volatile                       : 4
dmesg tail:
  [ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, pid=0, ip=00000000
```

jin: grabbing historical trend now. quick look: 6 days ago page_retire=52, now 142. That's a sustained growth rate, not a single blip. Also seeing small repeats of Xid 13 in the kernel logs.

maria: agreed — this looks like a memory cell getting progressively remapped. I'll start cordon+drain for gpu-pool7-003:card3. Migrating ~18 pods; ETA ~10:05.

leo: opened hardware vendor ticket VIN-9283 and attached nvml dumps + dmesg. Vendor asked for nvml logs and a short-term drain plan. Ticket: https://vendor.example/tickets/9283

jin: capacity note: pool7 total GPUs=48. Removing 1 GPU => ~2.1% raw capacity loss, but this host backs several batch-heavy shards so expected perf impact on those jobs ~8-12% until we rebalance. Recommend shifting latency-sensitive routes off pool7.

maria: initiated drain at 1812345720 — pods are being rescheduled. Cordoned host with k8s taint gpu-damaged=true:NoSchedule.

ashley: I bumped autoscale for pool3-east by +4 GPUs as a temporary buffer. Cost estimate for the bump ~ $1,800/day.

jin: running a health-check script to collect per-GPU error counters and nvml state: `gpu-health-check --host gpu-pool7-003 --gpus 0-3 --since 7d --out /tmp/gpu-pool7-003-dump.tar.gz`

ops-bot: ACTION: drain started by maria at 1812345720. Host cordoned; scheduler migration in progress. Monitoring will suppress repeat page-retire alerts for 24h while host is drained.

leo: leaving note in fleet DB: label="row-remap-growth"; suspected module-level degradation. Will follow up with hardware RMA once vendor confirms.

ashley: filing short incident note for on-call runbook: impact low but risk to batch SLAs. tagging for postmortem.

jin: plan for next steps: 1) complete RMA ticket with vendor 2) run extended burn-in on replacement module before reinstate 3) keep autoscale bump till capacity stabilized.

maria: drain completed at 1812345825, all pods migrated successfully. marking host as "awaiting RMA" in fleet UI.

leo: closing this thread for now — monitoring alert muted for gpu-pool7-003. I'll update ticket VIN-9283 with final logs and next steps.
